summary: Short kerb on a busy multi-lane road by a school; no parking convention.
reasons: Multi-lane through road, no cars parked
Passenger loading zone sign at school

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bush and school buildings 20 m or more away; no dwellings near, but the kerb is exposed to a busy road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane is the only room; one car seen at the kerb in QLD 2022 but none in Esri 2025.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial bend with a school crossing; constant traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: No parking convention; signed passenger loading zone 2 min max on school days.

flags: Loading zone sign 10.7 m away, school hours
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the west side; open to the afternoon sun at the kerb edge.

best_section.where: Taringa Parade west kerb, beside school grounds and bus shelters
